title: Engineering & Process Improvement Expert
desc:
The Job
Provide engineering expertise, techniques and methodologies to assist in identifying and implementing improvements in the areas of business activities, sequence of operations/work flows, staffing, handling methods and equipment
Provide field support and expertise to country management on facilities and related productivity issues.
Manage the day to day based activities on Engineering Projects ensuring that there is an optimal return on investments (facilities, process equipment) and implementation of regional optimisation projects
Ensure cost effective selection of facilities, equipment and layouts. Identify, evaluate & implement improvements in equipment & processes and handling operations
Responsible for the deployment of various engineering tools developed by regional office to the facilities in Turkey
The Person
Bachelor’s degree graduation, preferably in related fields such as; Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Process Engineering or types of Engineering
Excellent command of both written and spoken English
Minimum 2 years of experience
B class driving licence
Analytical thinking ability with strong planning and organizational skills
Self motivated and result oriented
Comfortable in communicating with diverse individuals
Teamwork oriented with good communication and interpersonal skills
Willingness to work under challenging circumstances and environment
Adaptable to flexible working hours
Good level of MS Office applications, preferably Power Platform and Automation tools
No travel restrictions
